problem:
The affine transformation $T$ is defined as

$$
x=2u-3v-4,\,y=2u-4v-5.
$$

Given that the inverse transformation ${T}^{-1}$ of $T$ is

$$
u=2x+ay+b,\,v=x-y+c,
$$

what is the value of $a+b+c?$

feedback.problem:
The affine transformation $T$ is defined as

$$
x=5v-7u+3,\,y=7v-10u+5.
$$

Given that the inverse transformation ${T}^{-1}$ of $T$ is

$$
u=ax-5y+4,\,v=bx+cy+5,
$$

what is the value of $a+b+c?$
feedback.worked_solution:
An affine transformation $T:{R}^{2}\to {R}^{2}$ is a function of the form

$$
x=Au+b,
$$

where $x,u,$ and $b$ are column vectors in ${R}^{2},$ and $A$ is a $2\times 2$ matrix.

Reversing the action of $T,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}Au+b & =x \\ Au & =x-b \\ u & ={A}^{-1}(x-b).\end{aligned}
$$

So, writing our transformation in matrix form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}5v-7u+3 \\ 7v-10u+5\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-7u+5v \\ -10u+7v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 5\end{aligned}] \\  & ={{[\begin{aligned}-7 & 5 \\ -10 & 7\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{A}\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{u}+{{[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 5\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{b}.\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we calculate the inverse of $A:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{A}^{-1} & =\frac{1}{7\cdot (-7)-5\cdot (-10)}[\begin{aligned}7 & -5 \\ 10 & -7\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}7 & -5 \\ 10 & -7\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the inverse transformation ${T}^{-1}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{{[\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{u} & ={{[\begin{aligned}7 & -5 \\ 10 & -7\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{A}^{-1}}\cdot ({{[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{x}-{{[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 5\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{b}) \\  & =[\begin{aligned}7 & -5 \\ 10 & -7\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x-3 \\ y-5\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}7\cdot (x-3)+(-5)\cdot (y-5) \\ 10\cdot (x-3)+(-7)\cdot (y-5)\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}7x-5y+4 \\ 10x-7y+5\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, the inverse transformation ${T}^{-1}$ in coordinate form is

$$
u=7x-5y+4,\,v=10x+(-7)y+5.
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
a+b+c=7+10+(-7)=10.
$$
